semanticPurpose: D1 그릴 화면의 고정 목재 frame과 빈 deep-indigo 작업면을 제공하는 불투명 complete background layer다.

sourceReferences.role: user-approved grill master; fixed camera, walnut/brass frame, work-surface material, safe areas and lighting reference only

generation.promptSummary: Remove every grill, food, rack, tray, tongs, button, VFX and UI object from the approved master; preserve only the fixed walnut/brass frame and empty deep-indigo workspace surface.
postProcess: no crop, compositing, colour edit, transparency conversion, or generated-pixel edit after source inspection

contains: one empty grill workspace background layer
no dynamic item, state, UI or other station

excludes: grill grate, charcoal bed, skewer, food, waiting rack, finished tray, discard tray, tongs, selector, button, smoke, spark, tare, fan, drink equipment, people, customer scene, and seating
text, quantity, timer, order rail, prepared dock, panel, button, icon, cursor, checkmark, logo, or watermark
nextGate: 고정층은 승인된 `BG-WORKSPACE-GRILL` R1과 `ST-GRILL-TIER-1` R2에서 멈춘다. 다음 단일 분리 후보는 빈 대기 rack `ST-GRILL-WAITING-RACK` 한 개이며, 생 네기마는 이미 승인된 조립 모듈의 동적 조합으로 별도 runtime 합성한다.
